compose_gtn_graphs: compose two weighted finite-state transducer graphs using gtn.compose to produce their intersection
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a GTN graph using gtn.forward_score for log-sum-exp over all paths
find_viterbi_path: find the highest-scoring path through a GTN graph using gtn.viterbi_path and gtn.viterbi_score
union_and_concat_graphs: build a union or concatenation of GTN graphs using gtn.union and gtn.concat for combining transducers
remove_epsilon_transitions: remove epsilon transitions from a GTN graph using gtn.remove to simplify the automaton
